concerns.text: The fallback data source uses the Materials Project API endpoint ("MP API endpoint – requires `MP_API_KEY` env var"). This is not a static URL from the verified‑datasets list, violating the constraint that *all external URLs must be from the verified‑datasets list*. Replace the fallback with a verified, versioned dataset URL (e.g., a HuggingFace mirror of the MP bulk files) or explicitly add the MP API endpoint to the verified‑datasets block.
